alekhine.name: Alekhine
alekhine.desc: Alexander Alekhine: dynamic, combinational, deep attacking play.

amanda.name: Amanda
amanda.desc: An attacker first, piece activity second. Plays gambits.

anand.name: Anand
anand.desc: Viswanathan Anand: fast, flexible and well-prepared, comfortable in sharp lines.

anderssen.name: Anderssen
anderssen.desc: Adolf Anderssen: romantic-era sacrifices and direct attacks.

bosboom.name: Bosboom
bosboom.desc: Manuel Bosboom: unconventional, provocative and tactical.

botvinnik.name: Botvinnik
botvinnik.desc: Mikhail Botvinnik: scientific, strategic, strong pawn structures.

cloe.name: Cloe
cloe.desc: Closed positions, pawn storms and a sound pawn structure; rooks on the one open file.

deborah.name: Deborah
deborah.desc: A defensive player who likes bishops.

defender.name: Defender
defender.desc: Solid and rational, a little pessimistic. Takes a draw in dead-equal positions.

dynamic.name: Dynamic
dynamic.desc: Dynamic piece play, values activity over material.

fischer.name: Fischer
fischer.desc: Bobby Fischer: clear, classical and relentlessly precise.

grumpy.name: Grumpy
grumpy.desc: Past his prime but dangerous: restricts your pieces, attacks, loves closed positions.

karpov.name: Karpov
karpov.desc: Anatoly Karpov: positional squeeze, takes away your counterplay.

kasparov.name: Kasparov
kasparov.desc: Garry Kasparov: dynamic initiative and powerful attacks.

kortchnoi.name: Korchnoi
kortchnoi.desc: Viktor Korchnoi: stubborn defender and counterattacker, grabs material.

larsen.name: Larsen
larsen.desc: Bent Larsen: original, fighting chess with offbeat openings.

marshall.name: Marshall
marshall.desc: Frank Marshall: swashbuckling attacks and traps.

morphy.name: Morphy
morphy.desc: Paul Morphy: mobility first, then the king attack. Prefers open positions.

nimzowitsch.name: Nimzowitsch
nimzowitsch.desc: Aron Nimzowitsch: restraint, blockade and prophylaxis.

partisan.name: Partisan
partisan.desc: Starts quietly without much central space, then launches vicious attacks.

pawnsacker.name: Pawnsacker
pawnsacker.desc: Flashy young talent who gives up pawns for activity a bit too often.

pedrita.name: Pedrita
pedrita.desc: Pawns, defence, restraint. Solid first, but attacks when the position asks.

petrosian.name: Petrosian
petrosian.desc: Tigran Petrosian: prophylaxis and safety first, very hard to beat.

preston.name: Preston
preston.desc: Mildly materialistic but fights for the initiative; pressure against your pieces.

reti.name: Réti
reti.desc: Richard Réti: hypermodern, controls the centre from afar.

rubinstein.name: Rubinstein
rubinstein.desc: Akiba Rubinstein: classical technique, superb endgames.

simple.name: Simple
simple.desc: Plain sensible evaluation, likes trading queens. The most computer-like.

spassky.name: Spassky
spassky.desc: Boris Spassky: universal style, attacks when the moment comes.

spitfire.name: Spitfire
spitfire.desc: Likes active play and keeping queens on, hates being attacked.

steinitz.name: Steinitz
steinitz.desc: Wilhelm Steinitz: solid accumulation of small advantages, accepts tough defence.

strangler.name: Strangler
strangler.desc: Boa-constrictor squeeze with a taste for positional sacrifices. Very human-like.

swapper.name: Swapper
swapper.desc: Happy to trade pieces and simplify into endgames.

tal.name: Tal
tal.desc: Mikhail Tal: sacrifices and wild attacks, king hunts at any cost.

tarrasch.name: Tarrasch
tarrasch.desc: Siegbert Tarrasch: active pieces, space and open lines.

topalov.name: Topalov
topalov.desc: Veselin Topalov: aggressive, exchange sacrifices and initiative.
